title: Shams: 'There's a slew of teams that are monitoring Kyrie Irving'
text:
Shams: 'There's a slew of teams that are monitoring Kyrie Irving' Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS Shams: 'There's a slew of teams that are monitoring Kyrie Irving'
 HoopsHype Oct. 28, 2026, 4:09 p.m. ET Shams Charania: "There's a slew of teams now that are monitoring Kyrie Irving. He's in the last year of his deal, he's got a player option next year. And so if you're a contending team and if the Mavericks are not really contending come trade deadline, do they look to trade him potentially to a contender for draft picks? That is what's also at the forefront of other teams' minds."
